generate_text_with_llama: create a HuggingfaceLlamaGenerator and call generate with a prompt and GenerationConfig to produce text
create_generation_config: build a GenerationConfig dataclass to set max_steps, temperature, top_p, and sampling parameters for LLM generation
implement_generation_strategy: create a subclass of GenerationStrategy and implement generate_token_ids to define custom token generation logic
create_logits_processors: call create_logits_processors on HuggingfaceLlamaGenerator to build a NoRepeatNGramLogitsProcessor from a GenerationConfig
create_stopping_criteria: call create_stopping_criteria on HuggingfaceLlamaGenerator to build StopStringCriteria from stop words in GenerationConfig
